slides: Everyone told you there's plenty of time
One man showed up for 20 straight years
While everyone else chased quick wins
Pick one skill today and master it for 365 days
Follow for rules your 20s depend on
caption:
These 5 rules can save your 20s. Self improvement at your age isn't about finding yourself. It's about building a man worth finding.

A man was once asked to dedicate 20 years of his life to preparation. No quick results. No shortcuts. No fame until the work was done. He agreed without blinking.

Meanwhile you can't commit to a morning routine for 20 days.

I call it the plenty of time lie. Everyone tells you to explore. Take your time. That advice sounds wise until you're 30 with nothing built and no discipline to show for it.

Your 20s are a weapon. But only if you aim them at something and don't flinch for years.

Pick one thing. Give it 365 days. No plan B. No restarts.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
